quotes.text: The return for people who start fast and are now being asked what they'll stay for.
Aries is the sign of starting things, acting on your own and going first. Saturn there asks for the slower version of that: leadership that holds up over time.
quotes.source: launch-kit-v2 (c) bonus style 6: the Aries sign page's about line, as the kit shortens it

quotes.text: Three passes. Not a day. Not a birthday.
quotes.footer: Your Saturn return is a season, with dates

quotes.text: The first one was about what you had to prove. This one's about what outlasts you.
The return for people who built something safe and now have to ask whether it's still good.
Saturn stops on 11 December at 7.9° Aries. If yours is within a degree, this is your closest turn.
